clips.title: The story
paras: Temple Gardens gather the waters and bridges at Darnassus's heart, with the city bank on their main island. The Temple of the Moon borders them to the south, and a glowing tree portal carries travelers to Teldrassil's base.

Water and wooden bridges cross the center of Darnassus, linking the Temple Gardens' islets to the Cenarion Enclave in the north, the terraces to the east, and the Temple of the Moon to the south. Night elves tend the flowing waters and foliage, making a quiet place of rest for travelers and priestesses.

The main island holds Darnassus's central vault and bank. On the western bank, a massive glowing pink tree portal carries travelers through the boughs to Rut'theran Village at Teldrassil's base. From there, the coastal docks and flight paths connect the World Tree to other destinations.
